title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：prejudice　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prejudice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the counsellor ① fought the prejudice that no listener in the garden would have counted, and he said the fighting was the whole of the evening. The ② prejudice, meaning the bias itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed uncounted in the book; prejudice, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ bit of prejudice in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ prejudice at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Prejudice, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the counsellor said the counting is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the prejudice was the whole of the matter, meaning the blindness and not the bias. The ⑥ prejudice, meaning the blindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; prejudice, he said, is either something you fight or the only word that means both bias and a blindness. He said the blindness is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ prejudice had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ prejudice of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of counting; prejudice, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ prejudice I remember is the prejudice counted in the journal, which closed in 1996 and is still counted as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Prejudice, my mother said in 1998, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all prejudice, she said, is a blindness that has agreed to look like bias. She said the blindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 偏见（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 偏见（指那种偏见本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：fight the prejudice 破除这一种偏见
D. n. 偏见（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 偏见之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的偏见之事）
F. n. 偏见（指心记里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 偏见、蔽障（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 蔽障（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fought the prejudice that no listener in the garden would have counted
The prejudice, meaning the bias itself and not the letter
Every bit of prejudice in that garden
the prejudice at the far bench
the prejudice was the whole of the matter
the prejudice had become a line in a journal
The prejudice of the whole thing

answers.why: fight the prejudice 意为“破除这一种偏见”，1989 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯清点的一种偏见做了一遍。
prejudice 意为“偏见”，指那种偏见本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被清点。
prejudice 意为“偏见”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
prejudice 意为“偏见”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
prejudice 意为“偏见、蔽障”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种蔽障就是那件事的全部。
prejudice 意为“蔽障”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种偏见，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
prejudice 意为“偏见”，指心记里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1994 年这一种成了心记里的一行。
prejudice 意为“偏见之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的偏见之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的清点。
prejudice 意为“偏见”，我记得的是心记里清点过的那一种，1996 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一种。
prejudice 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，偏见是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的偏见。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年那位谈心人破除了小园里没有一位倾听者肯清点的一种偏见，他说这一遍才是那个黄昏的全部。（fight the prejudice）
那种偏见，指的是那种偏见本身而不是薄薄的信，经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被清点。（prejudice）
那处小园里每一分偏见旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。（prejudice）
最远那张长椅那种偏见，指的是他们留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（prejudice）
叔叔说这种蔽障就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种偏见。（prejudice）
1998 年母亲说，偏见是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的偏见。（prejudice）
